remarks: NEW PRICE!!!! Sunny and inviting one bedroom apartment in a prime location in the complex! This end unit offers windows on 3 sides; bringing in south, west and north light. Within minutes to the train, library and town center. Convenient to just about everything and directly across from beautiful Mead Park. Kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite counters, tile backsplash and pantry closet. Just off the kitchen is the private deck with easy access to parking, and storage. Gleaming hardwood floors, high ceilings, built in shelving in the bedroom, large closet in the living room and more. HEAT AND HOT WATER INCLUDED IN RENT. Storage unit in the shared basement plus immaculate coin operated laundry room.
